derivation.method: Concise paraphrase of visible help facts. Raw accessibility snapshots, session-derived URLs and full provider help passages omitted.

facts: The player selects a stake and target multiplier before starting the wheel.
Adjust stake and target, then start the round. Green is the winning sector; the other sector is empty.
AUTO allows selection of a round count, stake, target and stopping conditions.
The help labels menu, sound, speed mode, stake increase, stake/target adjustment, start, balance and last-win controls.
The provider describes automatic handling of an active wager after disconnection and turning AUTO off.
The panel displays 96% RTP and version v1.0.1. It states that player speed or skill does not determine the result.

interpretationLimits: These facts do not specify the complete target/stake ladder, rounding policy or independent RNG probabilities.
The displayed provider RTP is not a verified RTP for the new ZPLAY engine.
Disconnection wording is not sufficient to calculate a local refund or settlement; accepted server receipts remain authoritative.
